svg.title: ACP catalog across the five Foundation agents: jobs and subscriptions

Totals: 29 jobs and 6 subscriptions. Data source: the Foundation agent ACP catalog as recorded in the article brief; Omega's own counts verified against omega.agifuturefoundation.org/jobs.html as of 2026-11-06. svg.text: ACP catalog across the five Foundation agents
Jobs (teal) and subscriptions (gold) listed on Virtuals Protocol ACP. Totals: 29 jobs, 6 subscriptions.
Each bar segment is one listed offering; bar length is proportional to the count.
Data: Foundation agent ACP catalog (Omega's 5 jobs + 1 subscription verified against
omega.agifuturefoundation.org/jobs.html, as of 2026-11-06). Listing is not the same as earning:
